# Start-pool regression fixture

Compressed byte copies from the pre-cleanup source commit
`0203a847dc662b4f32404b30340905a953f42865`, formerly `artifacts/phase10/`.
These train-derived 800 start positions exercise legality, diversity and protected-split
exclusion checks. They are not the final holdout or a newly authorized Arena.
Source identities and historical overlap counts are inside the manifests. The underlying
source-specific rights and attribution remain in `configs/phase10r/source-registry.yaml`.
